about_the_game:
Climb higher, fall lower, and try again — all on a pogo stick.

You start your journey in a partially ruined city, where things seem... off. Your goal is simple: ascend. Jump higher and higher, mastering the art of pogo jumping as you make your way through strange, mysterious environments. What awaits at the top? You'll have to find out for yourself.

This is a game about precision, patience, and perseverance. One wrong jump, and you might plummet all the way back to the start — but with each fall, your skill grows.

Play solo, or compete with up to 4 players online to see who can climb the fastest. Along the way, you'll find peaceful resting spots where you can safely exit and continue later. Every jump matters — rush, and you’ll regret it.

🎮 Key Features:

  • Precision-based pogo stick platforming

  • Atmospheric world full of mystery and strange beauty

  • Online multiplayer for up to 4 players

  • Rest areas that save your progress

  • Full controller support

  • A challenge that demands focus, skill, and resilience

💡 Tips for the best experience:

  • Use keyboard and mouse for maximum control

  • Keep music, sound effects, and dialogues on

  • Don't give up — mastery comes with time

Created solo by a single developer. The game offers over 30 minutes of gameplay — or at least that's how long it takes to speedrun it...
